text:

text:

title: Withdrawal
text:

The Authority Representative shall comply with the Technical Specifications before the delivery date stated in the Purchase Order. The Authority Representative shall keep a record of every batch supplied in the form set out in the Schedules. The Authority may reject any consignment that fails the acceptance test subject to the Special Conditions of Contract. The Supplier shall notify the other party in writing before the delivery date stated in the Purchase Order.
The Authority shall keep a record of every batch supplied throughout the Contract Period. The Authority Representative shall label each container with the batch number and the date of manufacture throughout the Contract Period. The Tenderer shall label each container with the batch number and the date of manufacture within fourteen days of the Purchase Order. The Authority shall keep a record of every batch supplied before the delivery date stated in the Purchase Order.
The Authority may reject any consignment that fails the acceptance test without prejudice to any other remedy. The Supplier shall comply with the Technical Specifications unless otherwise agreed in writing. The Supplier shall submit the monthly delivery programme where the Goods are supplied in bulk. The Tenderer shall label each container with the batch number and the date of manufacture before the delivery date stated in the Purchase Order.
